the GSC platform offers a complete and accurate picture of the current Bibliometrics community, but the other platforms (ResearchGate, ResearcherID and Twitter) offer a very incomplete picture of the community, with a lot of errors and omissions.
the use of the GSC platform for measuring the academic impact and visibility of the Bibliometrics, Scientometry, Informetrics, and Altmetrics scientific community is a reliable and useful tool.

The main takeaway from our work is that
, although the current scientific communication is being transformed by the Web, the bibliographic databases still provide a more complete picture of the scientific community.

, despite the fact that the data provided by the platforms analyzed in the study are incomplete, they can be used to provide a general idea of the scientific impact of a researcher, as long as they are used with caution.

the use of these platforms should be taken into consideration by the scientific community as an additional tool for self-assessment and self-promotion, as well as a way to keep track of the impact of one‘s work on a global scale.
